about_the_game:
• Epic Fantasy Artwork:

    • The table features a powerful warrior with glowing armor and a flaming sword, setting the stage for an intense pinball experience.

    • The sidewalls depict mystical scenes, such as a castle and a celestial dragon, reinforcing the high-fantasy theme.

  • Table Mechanics & Interactive Elements:

    • Golden Loop Ramps: A set of intricate golden rails—possibly used for skill shots or unlocking special bonuses.

    • Fire-Themed Flippers & Bumpers: The glowing orange design suggests a fire-elemental power-up or spell-casting mechanic.

    • Magic Portals & Lanterns: The table sides have glowing elements, which could indicate teleportation mechanics or hidden bonuses.

  • Gameplay Features Inspired by the Image:

    • Hero’s Quest Missions: Players might need to complete objectives such as collecting rune symbols, battling a dark sorcerer, or saving a kingdom.

    • Boss Battle Mode: A special event where targets activate a showdown against a powerful enemy (e.g., the warrior on the playfield).

    • Spell Activation: Hitting certain bumpers or ramps could charge up elemental spells—fireballs, lightning strikes, or healing effects.

  • Mini-Game Mode Ideas:

    • Dragon’s Trial: A smaller playfield where players must guide the ball through moving ramps while avoiding obstacles.

    • Castle Siege: A mode where breaking barriers leads to a final battle against an enemy force.

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunger
